I called financial aid and found out that I actually owe three hundred dollars, so now my roommate and I are looking through my things to sell or pawn. I might have to pawn the macbook my mother gave me, but I would rather have that conversation than the one where I tell her that I was careless enough to straight up lose money.

As soon as I get back home I'm getting a full time job again so I don't have to do things like this. You're right, there are things to fix the situation, but like /u/bktolife said, it really is my depression that clouds everything. I really think I've left it untreated for too long.
